name: modern-web-guidance-src
description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
one_liner: A library of up-to-date 'best practice' lessons that teach an AI coding assistant the current right way to build a web page, so it stops suggesting outdated tricks.
buyer: A frontend tech lead at a digital agency who's tired of their AI coding assistant recommending deprecated web APIs and wants its output to match today's actual web standards.
business_use_cases: An agency bakes this guidance into every client project's AI assistant setup so junior devs' AI-generated code follows current accessibility and performance standards automatically.
A web dev bootcamp uses it to keep course material and its AI tutor's answers aligned with what's actually current best practice, not advice that's three years stale.
A dev-tooling vendor builds a 'compliance score' product that checks a codebase against this guidance and sells the report to engineering leads.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a premium guidance pack covering extra frameworks/stacks beyond the free core set
Offer an automated 'web best-practices audit' that scores any repo or live site against this guidance

steal_this: Build a CLI this weekend that runs this guidance against an existing repo and spits out a scorecard with a prioritized fix list, then sell it as a one-off audit to small agencies.
